National and postcode-level coverage statistics are dated aggregate evidence; selected-parcel serviceability requires exact current premises data and orderability validation.
Annual infrastructure reports and linked downloads are national or area-level context and do not independently establish current selected-parcel orderability or measured speed.
A performance-reporting collection and its aggregate publication catalogue do not establish selected-parcel broadband availability, current orderability or measured speed.
